text: Every year, temporary traffic and parking amendments are required to improve traffic operations and pedestrian safety during the annual Canadian National Exhibition (CNE), which takes place from August 16 to September 2, 2022.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the temporary traffic and parking regulations on streets in the vicinity of Exhibition Place that are impacted during the Canadian National Exhibition identified in Attachments 1 and 2 to the letter (July 4, 2024) from Councillor Gord Perks; the temporary parking regulations will override all existing regulations for the duration of this event, from August 16, 2024 to September 2, 2024.
